parallels.note: He touched her hand, and the fever left her. She got up and served him.

translations.web: He came and took her by the hand, and raised her up. The fever left her immediately, and she served them.
translations.bsb: So He went to her, took her by the hand, and helped her up. The fever left her, and she began to serve them.
translations.kjv: And he came and took her by the hand, and lifted her up; and immediately the fever left her, and she ministered unto them.
translations.asv: and he came and took her by the hand, and raised her up; and the fever left her, and she ministered unto them.
